originality.rationale: The assessed distributional identity combines the unique matching contraction with independent 4-way endpoint lifts and fair thinning of a quotient Prüfer code. Heuberger–Wagner prove unique perfect matchings, Remmel–Williamson give unconditional fixed-leaf enumerations, and OEIS A375105 has the total perfect-matchable tree count, all credited. A retrieved complete-bipartite matching-conditioned model has only two lifts per quotient edge; its distance profile does not imply the present independent pair-leaf flags. Relevant published records did not show this exact complete-graph conditional occupancy distribution. The remaining historical-priority risk is genuine and explicitly qualified.
